in_text_mentions: Under dermoscopy, a papule on the left volar forearm showed red thin papules with dark and light brown dots distributed within and outside of the red-purple coloration, respectively (Figure 3).

In our report, dermoscopy revealed red thin papules with light and dark brown dots distributed outside and within of the discoloration, respectively (Figure 3). Histopathology was significant for focal positive staining within the stratum corneum on Fontana-Masson in the location of these spots, indicative of focal melanin deposition (Figure 5). No previous reports of PLEVA have described melanin deposition in the stratum corneum. However, PLC has been noted to have flecks of melanin within the stratum corneum with associated parakeratosis [8].
